records.title: 10-K
records.text: Applebee’s system-wide domestic same-restaurant sales increased 34.8% for the three months ended December 31, 2021 and increased 38.2% for the year ended December 31, 2021 as compared to the comparable periods of 2020.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The increase in customer traffic primarily was due to the relaxation or removal over the course of 2021 of government-mandated restrictions on restaurant operating capacity that had been in place during 2020, as well as increased consumer desire to patronize restaurants after the relaxation of pandemic restrictions.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The June 2021 issue of Nation's Restaurant News reported that IHOP was the largest restaurant system in the family dining category and Applebee's was the fourth largest restaurant system in the casual dining category, in terms of United States system-wide sales during 2020.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The significant increase in in income before income taxes in 2021 compared to 2020 was due to the increase in gross profit and the absence of significant impairment charges taken in 2020 that did not recur, partially offset by higher G&A expenses.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Approximately $13.7 million was collected during the year ended December 31, 2021, which had a favorable impact on cash provided by operating activities in 2021.
